title: Best Maize Farming Practices in Kenya 101
reason: This video contains multiple steps and processes related to maize farming, including soil preparation, variety selection, planting techniques, fertilization, and pest management.

tasks.task: Discuss the importance of choosing the right soil for maize farming.

subtasks.text: Explain that maize grows well in fertile loam or sandy loam soils.
